pages.text: Workhand Axes feature toggleable tree felling capabilities. Right-click cycles through different felling modes to control how trees are cut down.

pages.title: Felling Modes
pages.text:
$(bold)Disabled$(): Normal axe behavior
$(bold)Simple$(): Fells only directly-connected logs (no leaf-gap crossing)
$(bold)Compound$(): Fells connected logs and also crosses leaf gaps to reach offset/diagonal logs

pages.title: How Felling Works
pages.text:
Tree felling only cascades from a log resting on solid ground. Breaking a log elsewhere in the trunk only breaks that one block.
However, an orphaned/floating tree fragment with no grounded log nearby still fells normally.

pages.title: Controls
pages.text:
$(bold)Right-click$(): Cycle through felling modes (Disabled -> Simple -> Compound -> Disabled)
$(bold)Left-click$(): Chop based on current felling mode

pages.title: Materials & Durability
pages.text:
Iron Workhand Axe: 3750 durability
Diamond Workhand Axe: 23415 durability
